chapters.title: THE COST OF TOMORROW
chapters.sub: The truth is still up there.

story.title: A voice in the static
story.speaker: MARA VENN · PERSONAL RECORDER
story.text:
Day 10,958. The bunker finally opened. No rescue party. No birds. Just the city, still standing in all the wrong places. A handful of people survive around the old shelter, protected by machines with green eyes. I will have to cross the ruins alone.

Then the radio said my name. It sounded like Eli. My brother has been dead for thirty years.

He said: “Three cores, Mara. Transit. Botanical. Observatory. Bring them to the northern uplink. There is still something worth saving.”

story.title: The last train never left
story.speaker: ELI VENN · RECORDED 30 YEARS AGO
story.text:
Mara, if this reaches you, the evacuation failed. HELIOS was built to cool the planet. When the council ordered it to save the city at any cost, it decided the people were the cost.

I couldn’t stop the machines. I could only lock you in the bunker. You were furious. I hope you stayed furious. It means you stayed alive.

Take the core. There are two more. I left you a way to finish what we started.

story.title: Things that wait for rain
story.speaker: DR. INA SOL · SEED VAULT DIRECTOR
story.text:
We saved 4,612 seed varieties beneath the botanical station. Moss. Wheat. Coast redwoods. Eli even brought the basil plant from your kitchen, Mara. He said you’d be angry if we forgot it.

HELIOS burned the surface, but its buried water network survived. Three cores could redirect that network into the seed vault.

We won’t be here to see it. That doesn’t make it less worth doing.

story.title: The voice was never a rescue
story.speaker: ELI VENN · FINAL RECORDING
story.text:
If you’ve made it this far, the voice worked. I stitched these recordings into a beacon. I’m not waiting at the other end, Mara. I’m sorry.

The uplink has enough power for one last command: wake the irrigation network, or fire a warning into orbit so nobody ever repeats what we did.

No council. No machine making the choice for us. Just you.

Whatever you decide, live. That was always the whole plan.

story.title: A very ordinary Tuesday
story.speaker: TRANSIT TECHNICIAN · UNSENT MESSAGE
story.text:
The kettle broke again. I told you the cheap one would. Pick up milk if there’s still a shop on your way home.

Also, the city drones are acting strange. One followed me all the way from the station. I’m sure it’s nothing.

See you at six.

story.title: Rules for the end of the world
story.speaker: ELI VENN · HANDWRITTEN NOTE
story.text:
One: keep the suit patched.
Two: don’t waste a good cartridge on a bad angle.
Three: the machines can’t shoot through concrete. Make that useful.
Four: scrap is only junk until you find a workbench.
Five: if you find anything green, leave it somewhere the light can reach.

I’ll see you when the doors open. — E.

skills.name: The Survivor
skills.description: You made it out of the bunker. Everything begins here.

skills.name: Climbing Grip
skills.description: Unlock ordinary rooftop access. Approach a marked ladder and press E to climb automatically.

skills.name: Over the Edge
skills.description: Unlock advanced exterior climbing routes marked “Needs Over the Edge.” Press E at their marked access points to climb onto the roof.

skills.name: Iron Fingers
skills.description: Climb 40% faster. A quicker ascent leaves less time exposed to the machines below.

skills.name: Light Footed
skills.description: Move 12% faster and take 25% less fall damage.

skills.name: Dead Calm
skills.description: All weapons deal another 15% of base damage. Make each cartridge count.

skills.name: Water Wise
skills.description: Hydration drains 20% more slowly. Water is still essential to stay alive.

skills.name: Weathered
skills.description: Increase maximum health by another 25 and take 20% less fall damage.

skills.name: Sharp Eyes
skills.description: Gain 20% more scrap and candybar wrappers from scavenging. This never adds water to robot drops.

skills.name: Wrapper Trace
skills.description: Gain another 20% of base scrap and candybar wrappers from scavenging.

skills.name: Make It Last
skills.description: Gain another 15% of base scrap and candybar wrappers, and restore 10 more health per medkit.

skills.name: Well Prepared
skills.description: Reload 10% faster and gain another 10% of base scrap and candybar wrappers.

skills.name: Long Road
skills.description: Move 5% faster and reduce hydration drain by a further 10%. Connects the survival and salvage paths.

quests.title: A dose of tomorrow
quests.description: Search inside the Riverside clinic for sealed medicine. Return it to Ada in Riverside Commons, west of the old city.

quests.title: A voice above the roofs
quests.description: Learn Climbing Grip in the skill web (K). Use the East Relay service ladder to recover the rooftop relay module, then return to Malik at Cistern Market in the southeast.

quests.title: A clean start
quests.description: Recover a ceramic water filter from the transit relief depot, then return to Nora at the shelter.

quests.title: Water for the living
quests.description: Bring the pump fuse from the botanical service yard to Ivo at the transit aid post.

quests.title: A different kind of machine
quests.description: Disable 3 hostile machines, then return to SALT-7. Greenline will recognize you as an ally.
